A

System overview & processes

Why the Dashboard exists, how it identifies you, and how the recruiting day actually runs.

01

Purpose & background

This SOP describes the complete operation of the Recruiting Dashboard, the system of record for all recruiting activity. It replaced the legacy Excel workbook after the audit numbers above. Four principles hold on every screen:

🪪

One identity per person

The phone number is the identity key. Re-applications reopen the existing record with full history; duplicates are impossible by design.

✍️

Every action is signed

Calls, blocks, notes, hires, checklist marks: stamped with who and when, automatically.

⚙️

Rules enforce themselves

Attempt limits, no-show blocks, rehire memory — no human memory required.

🗄️

Nothing is deleted

Records are blocked, archived, or made dormant. History is permanent. Every reversal tool leaves a signed note.

04

Roles

Assigned per day from the Supervisor Panel. Roles adjust what the system reminds you of — never what you can do.

Role

Sourcing

Posts/closes ads (Paradox), headhunts, extracts the daily list (100–120 by office needs), hands lists to Screening, maintains tags/zip codes. Works mostly outside the app.

Role

Screening

Uploads lists (becomes Owner), calls, screens, schedules AND runs Zoom interviews, advances to orientation.

Role

Scheduling & BGC

From the booked appointment onward: creates WellSky profiles, captures DOB/SSN/DL, runs the 10 background requirements, sends reminders and the orientation email, records CCM decisions, closes backgrounds. MY PENDING shows appointments from ALL recruiters.

Role · default

Full flow

Everything end to end. Default when nothing is assigned.

05

Daily process — the recruiter's day

Open My Day: read your role banner, the news banner if red, your numbers, MY PENDING (your to-do), TOMORROW'S APPOINTMENTS.
Load new leads if you received lists: paste → Parse → review colors → Load.
Work the queue in Calls: most-forgotten first; log every dial.
Before ANY call outside your queue: Search — read the traffic light.
Advance, schedule, record results on the card as the day unfolds.
BGC desk: capture data early (any scheduled person is capturable), run requirement batches with the Missing filter.
Day before appointments: send reminders (envelopes) and the orientation email.
After orientations: record the CCM's answer the same day.
06

The automatic rules

3×

Three attempts, no contact

Automatic Dormant, leaves the queue. Recoverable in the Reengagement Pool. Contact results reset nothing — the counter continues per cycle; Reengage resets it.

2×

Two NCNS, anywhere

Zoom or orientation, combined → permanent automatic block ("Second NCNS"). First NCNS is recorded, not punished. Rescheduling with notice NEVER counts as NCNS.

📌

Rehire memory

A CCM's answer (Priority / Do not rehire) is recorded once and permanent. Orange "Verify with CCM" people are never advanced without asking first.

🚫

Blocked people cannot enter

The batch loader rejects them on paste; search shows red with reason, author, date.

📅

Follow-up resurrection

"Interested - call back later" hides the person until their date, then surfaces them in MY PENDING as "Follow-up due."

🩺

Hires stay at the BGC desk

Until a final verdict (Passed / Did not pass) is recorded.

07

Metric attribution — the three credits

MetricCredited to
CallsWhoever makes the call (automatic signature).
ZoomsWhoever logs the Advances.
HiresWhoever is chosen in the "Hired by" selector when Moving forward is saved (defaults to the person saving). The system separately stamps who recorded it; reports show "(recorded by ...)" when they differ.

Owner = who uploaded the lead. Governs queue membership and transfers only. Never changes because someone else worked the lead. Not a metric.

🎯

Weekly goals per recruiter: 200 calls · 25 zooms · 10 hires — equal for all, regardless of role.

🤝

Team agreement: the orientation result is recorded by (or credited to) the person who worked the case. Every step is signed — misuse is visible.

Search screen

Search boxType digits → searches by phone; type text → searches by name. Partial matches anywhere in the field.

Traffic-light states — in priority order

Blocked — [reason] ([who], [date])Do not proceed. Includes automatic blocks (Second NCNS, Did not pass BGC) and manual ones.
On black list — name match, verify identityA legacy blacklist name matches. Confirm identity before anything ("Not the same person" button clears false matches; confirming seals a real block).
Priority — rehirableCCM-confirmed rehire. Fast-track.
Verify with CCMFormer caregiver, no rehire decision on file. Ask the CCM before advancing; the answer is saved forever.
Known — N previous calls, no restrictionsFull history on the card.
OK — no restrictionsNew to us.

HAS NOTES suffix: the card carries notes; read them before dialing.

Result behaviors

Voicemail left / no-contact results → attempt counted; on the 3rd consecutive no-contact, automatic Dormant.
Contact results (answered, asked to call back, language barrier, etc.) → Lead becomes Contacted.
Advances → books the Zoom (or orientation when the Zoom step is off) and moves the stage. Counts toward your 25 zooms.
Not interested / Does not qualify → reason required → Lost, reason + signature visible on the card forever.
Interested - call back later → date picker appears → Dormant with a follow-up date + automatic signed note; resurfaces in MY PENDING on the date.
👥

Calling someone else's lead: the call signs with YOUR name; the Owner never changes.

Action blocks — appear by moment

BlockAppears whenControls & behavior
SCHEDULELead/Contacted, OpenType dropdown (Schedule zoom / Schedule orientation) + date/time (+office for orientation). Choosing orientation = Zoom bypass: the reason box appears and is MANDATORY; saving stamps the permanent bypass note.
ZOOM RESULTZoom scheduled, OpenPassed - schedule orientation (reveals date/time/office) · No-show (NCNS +1; 2nd = auto-block) · Reschedule zoom (new date; reschedule +1).
ORIENTATION RESULTOrientation scheduled, OpenMoving forward → reveals the "Hired by" selector (defaults to you — change it when recording for a colleague) + CCM name box → Hired, stays at BGC desk. · Did not move forward → reason mandatory → Lost. · NCNS → counter/auto-block. · Reschedule orientation → new date/time/office (office pre-loads current; reschedule +1). · Orientation cancelled → note mandatory → back to Contacted, appointment cleared, NO NCNS, NO reschedule count, signed note in Notes.

Utility buttons

ButtonAppears whenWhat it does
Fix appointmentZoom/Orientation scheduledCorrects date/time/office of the EXISTING appointment (typo repair). Does NOT touch the reschedule counter. Distinction: candidate asked to move = Reschedule (counts); we typed it wrong = Fix (doesn't).
Undo advanceZoom/Orientation scheduledReverts a mistaken advance: back to Contacted, appointment cleared, signed note "Advance undone (was ...)". Call history untouched.
Reengage - assign to meDormant or Lost (and legacy Hired = ex-employees)Returns them to Open in YOUR queue; attempt counter resets; "reengaged N×" increments; history intact.
No longer employedApp-era HiredThey left the company: Dormant + WasCaregiver + "Verify with CCM" — the boomerang flow will apply if they reapply.
Reopen background checkAny BGC verdict existsReverts a mistaken ✓ or ✗: clears the verdict, restores Hired (if the ✗ had demoted them), removes ONLY BGC-caused blocks, returns them to the desk with the checklist intact, signed note "(was ...)".
Not the same person - clear flagBlacklist name match, unblockedClears a false blacklist match, signed.
Add to my Outlook calendar(built, currently parked)Creates the appointment in the presser's Outlook calendar.

12.1 Employability — Block / Unblock

🚫

Block applicant

Visible on non-blocked. Reason catalog — Do not rehire - CCM / Did not pass BGC / No transportation / Attitude - soft skills / Not employable - other — + free-text detail → Block (red). Signs who/when. If Open or Hired → becomes Lost with the reason. "Do not rehire - CCM" also seals the permanent rehire decision with the CCM's name.

🔓

Manage block

Visible on blocked. The unblock box — a written reason is MANDATORY → Remove block. The constancy is preserved ("Unblocked [date] by [name]: [reason]"). CCM-caused blocks revert rehire status to "Verify with CCM" — not to clean.

All controls hide behind the toggle button to save card space; only the red constancy stays always visible.

12.2 Notes

  • Button label: "Add note" (none) / "Notes (N)" (collapsed, N existing) / "Hide notes" (open).
  • Open = existing notes (stacked, newest first, each "[author] · [date]: [text]") + the new-note box + Save note.
  • Notes never overwrite — they accumulate. Search shows "HAS NOTES" for anyone with notes.
  • The system also auto-writes notes: follow-up promises, cancellations, undone advances, reopened verdicts, unblocks.

The verdict

✓ Pass

The graduation: all complete and passed → stamps "BGC: Passed", person leaves the desk. Then: upload PDFs to WellSky (File Naming Tool); task Kate for any conviction/EMR/TXDPS review.

✗ Fail

Did not pass → automatic block ("Did not pass BGC" + your notes), removed from Hired (Lost), leaves the desk. Future applications rejected on sight.

↺ Reopen

Mistaken verdicts are reversed from the person's card: Reopen background check.
